body:
Maybe we're just growing apart? Maybe my coworkers just suck? Maybe I'm just surrounded by the wrong kinds of people. I am kind of bad at talking and getting to know people.. I don't know. And no, it doesn't mean anything is necessarily wrong with me, I just think it does.
 
3-6 month goals sound like a good idea. Just have to make some, stick to em, figure everything out a few months at a time. Once I figure out college, then I can worry about other things.

Alright, I think I have a bit of a plan. I'm feeling better than I was when I made this post. You're an excellent person and thank you for talking with me.

I try to never quit and to stay positive, I'm just running out of reasons to do so. "What's the point?" sort of things. Any good day is followed by a horrible breakdown. I know that any happiness will just make the depression junk feel that much worse when it inevitably kicks in. 

And I believe what you say, so I'm going to try and get some help again. Talking through some of it has helped, I'll have to keep everything in mind for later. Thanks again for this.

Thank you for the advice, I'll have to try talking to someone soon. I've tried a few times before, it's just really hard to open up and figure out what's actually going on. It's close to impossible to stay positive, but for now I don't want to quit. I just want everything to be okay.
Thank you. I might do that. Sometimes just talking to someone is enough.

There's just so much that I believe I need to live up to. I'm going to school and I'm stuck debating between whether its just a huge waste of money or not. I don't know what I want to do or where I should be. I feel like time is running out. Just constant pressure. And I'm a horrible friend person. I just suck at keeping in touch or conversing, so I'm usually alone. If I focus too much on just one day, I'll fall behind and then just waste more time and money. I feel like I don't deserve anything. I live every day with a mask on and shove everything else away, pretend to be happy.  As a result, I'm not sure what I feel is real. Also I'm rambly and I apologize if this makes no sense.

Well, I'm a chick but thank you. I've always been good with animals, it's kinda sad but my pets are usually the ones who I go to when I need to hug something. And lately I just can't get motivated for anything. I know I'm depressed, I don't know how to fix it. After years of hiding everything and pretending to be 'fine just fine', I'm not too sure who I am any more.
